d: Prashant Kapoor will discuss in this video... Team India's disappointing defeat against New Zealand and the big questions surrounding the team's performance! After another tough outing, cricket fans are questioning India's strategy, team selection and the performances of some key players. Is Kuldeep Yadav likely to be dropped from the Playing XI after this defeat? Was his performance responsible for India's struggles, or should the team management look at other areas before making changes? What went wrong with India's batting and bowling, and will Gautam Gambhir make some bold selection…
